release_notes: Session recordings and click heatmaps, Clarity-style, on your own server. Switch recording on per landing (landing editor → Session recording tab): share of visitors (5–100%), a recording window (1 h – 7 days or until switched off) and a live daily size estimate from real traffic. Watch them in ⚙ → Logs → Session recordings: filters by landing, device, duration, went-to-offer, conversion and rage clicks; a player with click marks, 1–8× speed and skip-inactivity; the click card links to its recording. Each landing gets a click heatmap (desktop/mobile, rage clicks marked) and a scroll map built from every measured visit. Storage limits shared by all landings: keep 1–30 days and at most 256 MB – 20 GB; when full, the oldest recordings are overwritten. Form fields are masked in the visitor's browser; bots and safe-page visitors are never recorded. No cron or server command needed after the update.
